t: What is the concierge collection? And how does it work? | DIS Disney Discussion Forums - DISboards.com
s: June 10, 2007 - Options in the Collections are not guaranteed to always be there and the cost in points varies each year - usually they go up. While they do make for a nice change of pace, most here say the best economic use of a DVC point is using it to stay at a DVC resort. Don't buy DVC for the non-DVC options - buy only if you plan to regularly use your points for DVC resort.
